business_problem: Altana needed a better way to support generative AI trade classification, legal reasoning, and supply chain knowledge graph enrichment because the company needed to deploy many customer-specific models quickly without wasting time on boilerplate infrastructure, vendor lock-in, or fragmented evaluation tooling.
solution_summary: Altana uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support generative AI trade classification, legal reasoning, and supply chain knowledge graph enrichment. The implementation replaced a legacy state where the company needed to deploy many customer-specific models quickly without wasting time on boilerplate infrastructure, vendor lock-in, or fragmented evaluation tooling. Global trade data and customer supply chain data move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Model Serving, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver tariff classifications and legal write-ups.
business_outcome: Altana improved generative AI trade classification, legal reasoning, and supply chain knowledge graph enrichment with measurable results including 20x solving global trade challenges across the supply chain, 20–50% faster deployment of genai models into production, and Deploying GenAI models 20x faster with up to 50% improved performance, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.

architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.

evidence_quotes: These models generate what is the right tax and tariff classification of this good and then auto-generates an entire legal write-up that a customer can use for justification purposes,
We’re using Databricks to keep track of all the user input/output decisions so that we can identify which steps and models in the workflow need fine-tuning for cost, performance or latency reasons.
The ‘batteries included’ nature of Databricks allows us to do it all in one place and collaborate across our data ingest, data engineering, ML and software teams,

A key improvement for us was the model and LLM evaluation tools in MLflow, combined with Model Serving. These have allowed our ML teams to rapidly train, test and deploy their own models for customers.
